title: Tribal Warrior Poses
description: Two side-by-side views of a muscular, stylized male character with yellow and black tribal armor. The left shows him standing wide with both hands lifting two large yellow blocks labeled 'TRIBAL' above his head. The right shows a three-quarter view of the same character in a combat stance with fists raised near his face.
prompt: A highly detailed stylized muscular male warrior with dark skin and tribal face markings, wearing heavy yellow and black armor with skull motifs and knee pads. He has two large yellow blocks labeled TRIBAL balanced on his shoulders. Shown in two poses: one lifting the blocks overhead with wide stance, the other in a fighting stance with fists up, rendered in realistic 3D figure style with dramatic studio lighting on dark background.
